title: Playboy Magazine October 1972 Bunnies of 1972 Daniel Ellsberg Pentagon Papers
conditionDescription: Pre-owned vintage issue, complete. These 1972 issues show vintage wear including cover rubbing/scuffing, edge and corner wear and creasing consistent with their age. Please review the photos for exact condition. The centerfold has not been separately verified - please ask before buying if that matters to you.
descriptionText:
Vintage Playboy Magazine, October 1972 issue. Cover price one dollar.

Features:
- Playboy's Bunnies of 1972
- Beyond the Pentagon Papers: Joe McGinniss on Daniel Ellsberg
- The bizarre story of an American millionaire's Mexican jailbreak
- Jazz & Pop Poll Ballot
